title: THE CO-OP HUD DRAWS WHERE IT SHOULD
why: Found by the review of 2026-10-07: in a party raid the teammate rows (name, health, armour), the kill feed, the pings and the controller paused word were drawn inside the zoom of the health corner, so everything they drew was pushed up and out. At 1080p the teammate rows sat in the top left corner over the CURRENT PILLAGERS board, and at 1440p and 4K (where he plays) the rows, the kill feed and the pings were drawn off the screen altogether. They now draw where they should: the teammate rows down the left below the board, the kill feed on the right below CONDITIONS, both grown with the screen, and the status icons below the teammate rows.
now: In two player raids your teammate health, the kill feed and pings show on screen at every resolution.
